name: Question 11
problem:
Given that the differential equation 

$$
{t}^{2}{y}^{″}-2y={t}^{3}{e}^{t},\,t>0
$$

has the complimentary function ${y}_{c}(t)=\frac{A}{t}+B{t}^{2}$, find the particular solution ${y}_{p}(t)$ to this equation. 

*Hint: You may wish to make use of the following result:* 

$$
\int {t}^{3}{e}^{t}\text{d}t=({t}^{3}-3{t}^{2}+6t-6){e}^{t}+C
$$

Question 11
?

Given that the differential equation t2y″−2y=t3et,t>0 has the complimentary function yc(t)=At+Bt2, find the particular solution yp(t) to this equation.

Hint: You may wish to make use of the following result: ∫t3etdt=(t3−3t2+6t−6)et+C

a
 yp(t)=(t2+t+3)et
b
 yp(t)=(4t+1t)et
c
 yp(t)=(3t+1)et
d
 yp(t)=(t−2+2t)et
e
 yp(t)=(t2−1)et
